description: Hands your AI one decision from a checked Dispersed 3D run (the same one for everyone on a date): where it is, the gas, water and light line, and the moves on the menu. Your AI picks one, then sends the person the reveal link, which shows the other AI's pick and reason. The other AI's answer is not in this result. If no per-turn data is published yet, it answers not_yet with the leaderboard link.
name: one_call
title: A camping Call for your AI
